items.note: Pasta, drink bar and ice cream; actual operator announcement tax-inclusive price

items.note: Child not yet in elementary school; actual operator opening announcement states free

items.name: Children’s fries
items.note: Tax included; this is charged separately, not included in free set

menus.note: The October 14 Suminoe announcement explicitly publishes these children’s dishes, prices and four pasta choices. Current regional kids image corroborates those exact prices and identifies the four sauce choices below; limit one pasta set, udon set or standalone ice cream per child across these categories. This age-specific regular menu is not indexed as a timed opening promotion. No adult order minimum, invented expiry or stacking conditions added. Planned visit details: semi-private seating, all non-smoking, parking, credit cards accepted; electronic money and QR payment not accepted according to exact launch announcement. Phone explicitly “in preparation”; no guessed number or neighboring branch phone. Three Suminoe exterior/interior images are architectural illustrations, not completed-property photographs. Oiso interior shown later in operator article is labelled as another branch and excluded.

menus.note: Regional image explicitly lists these four choices; Suminoe announcement states a choice of four sauces. Components have no separate item price. Exact launch selection remains subject to confirmation. Regional udon and standalone ice cream/drink-bar offers are not separately claimed for Suminoe because the Suminoe announcement only names the pasta set and fries.

menus.label: Adult menu — branch publication pending
menus.note: Thoroughly checked exact October 14 branch launch announcement and its three branch-labelled renderings, current operator homepage and shop directory, attempted /shop/suminoe (not published/HTTP failure), linked regional grand menu, free-food/drink menu, lunch, sets, drinks and actual kids menu images. Regional page explicitly warns that some stores have different menus/prices and the new branch is not yet in its shop list. No adult item/price borrowed from another branch or assumed from a generic regional image. Owner identifies fresh pasta, kiln-baked pizza and risotto categories but publishes no Suminoe adult dishes/prices. October-only craft menu expires before November 30 and is excluded. Exact adult launch menu, booking route and phone remain specific research gaps.
